summary: Halyard template titled mutual, but counterparty edits make it one-way in Broadwallbancorp's favour, add a 12-month restriction on Halyard, assign Halyard feedback and work product to the counterparty, and request New York law.

findings.quote: Counterparty or any member of its Group that discloses, or procures the disclosure of, Confidential Information to Halyard
findings.why: After the edit only the Counterparty can be the Disclosing Party, so Halyard's information is not protected even though the recitals say each Party may disclose.
findings.draft_redline: Disclosing Party means the Party that discloses, or procures the disclosure of, Confidential Information to the other Party under or in connection with this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We need this to remain a mutual agreement, as both parties expect to share information. We have restored the original definition so that either party can be the Disclosing Party.

findings.quote: Halyard in its capacity as the recipient of Confidential Information from or on behalf of the Disclosing Party
findings.why: After the edit only Halyard can be the Receiving Party, so all confidentiality obligations in clause 2 bind Halyard alone and the Counterparty owes none.
findings.draft_redline: Receiving Party means the Party that receives Confidential Information from or on behalf of the Disclosing Party under or in connection with this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: For the agreement to work for both of us, the obligations need to bind whichever party receives information. We have restored the original mutual definition.

findings.quote: which is either marked or identified as confidential at the time of disclosure or would reasonably be considered confidential given the nature of the information and the circumstances of its disclosure
findings.why: Definition covers information disclosed for the Purpose that is marked or reasonably confidential and includes derived notes and analyses, matching the preferred position (its one-sided operation is addressed under PB01).

findings.quote: the employees, officers, directors, professional advisers, auditors [[INS: , contractors]] and insurers of that Party
findings.why: Adding contractors to Representatives widens permitted onward disclosure slightly, but all preferred categories remain and disclosure stays need-to-know with the Receiving Party liable under clause 4.

findings.quote: not use or exploit the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in any way except solely for the Purpose
findings.why: Use is limited solely to the Purpose, which is a potential commercial relationship relating to enterprise software licensing and implementation services (a named-scope purpose).
findings.fallback_cited: Purpose limited to a named project, product evaluation or pilot.

findings.quote: not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble or otherwise attempt to derive the composition, source code or underlying structure of any software, prototypes or other tangible objects
findings.why: Reverse engineering is prohibited as preferred.

findings.quote: not enter into any agreement or arrangement to provide software or related implementation services substantially similar to those evaluated under the Purpose to any Tier 1 retail or investment banking institution operating in North America or the United Kingdom
findings.why: Inserted covenant restricts the Receiving Party (Halyard) from dealing with a class of customers for the term plus 12 months, which is a non-compete/restriction on dealing with customers.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 2.1.6 in its entirety and restore "; and" removal so that clause 2.1.5 ends the list with a full stop.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to accept restrictions on either party's ability to do business with other customers. We have deleted clause 2.1.6; confidentiality and use restrictions already protect your information.

findings.quote: can demonstrate by written records or other reasonable evidence
findings.why: All four carve-outs (public domain, already held, third-party receipt, independent development) are present without narrowing, with an accepted evidence standard.

findings.quote: may disclose the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information to those of its Representatives and members of its Group who strictly need to know
findings.why: Need-to-know disclosure to Representatives and Group members is permitted and the Receiving Party remains liable for them.

findings.quote: may disclose the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information to the minimum extent required by an order of any court of competent jurisdiction
findings.why: Compelled disclosure is permitted, notice is only where legally permitted, and resistance is at the Disclosing Party's cost.

findings.quote: copies of any Confidential Information that are securely stored in routine, automated electronic backup or archiving systems
findings.why: Ten Business Days, officer-signed confirmation, and exceptions for automated backups and legally required copies which stay confidential.

findings.quote: Halyard hereby irrevocably assigns to Counterparty with full title guarantee all right, title and interest (including all intellectual property rights) worldwide in and to such Work Product
findings.why: Inserted wording assigns to the Counterparty all IP in Halyard's feedback and any derivative works, which is an assignment of IP to the other party.
findings.draft_redline: Delete the inserted Work Product wording from clause 7.1 and restore clause 7.2 to read: "No right or licence, express or implied, is granted ...".
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are not able to assign intellectual property in feedback or derivative works. Each party keeps its own IP, and we have removed the Work Product wording.

findings.quote: grants to Counterparty and each member of its Group a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable and sublicensable licence to use, copy, modify and commercialise the same without restriction
findings.why: Fallback licence is far wider than use for the Purpose and could capture Halyard product information embodied in feedback or derivatives.
findings.draft_redline: Delete the inserted licence wording; no licence is granted other than use of Confidential Information solely for the Purpose.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We cannot grant a perpetual commercial licence over feedback or derivative works, as it could extend to our own product information. The only licence is to use Confidential Information for the Purpose.

findings.quote: Neither Party makes any representation or gives any warranty, express or implied, as to the accuracy, completeness, adequacy or fitness for a particular purpose of any Confidential Information
findings.why: Information is as is with a mutual no-warranty disclaimer, a fraud carve-out in 7.4 and no obligation to proceed in 7.5.

findings.quote: Neither Party shall make, or permit any person to make, any public announcement, press release or other public disclosure
findings.why: Mutual publicity restriction with consent requirement and legal-requirement exception.

findings.quote: The Parties do not anticipate that the disclosure of Confidential Information for the Purpose will involve the sharing or processing of any personal data
findings.why: No personal data beyond business contacts, and a separate DPA is required in 9.2 before sharing any other personal data.

findings.quote: for a period of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party giving not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice
findings.why: Two-year term with 30 days' notice, and confidentiality survives three years (Trade Secrets while they remain so) in 10.3.

findings.quote: a Party shall be entitled to seek the remedies of injunction, specific performance and other equitable relief
findings.why: Mutual right to seek equitable relief, with remedies cumulative in 11.2.

findings.quote: Neither Party may assign, novate, transfer, mortgage, charge, subcontract, declare a trust over or deal in any other manner with any or all of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party
findings.why: Mutual prohibition on assignment without prior written consent.

findings.quote: all vendor NDAs to be governed by the laws of the State of New York with exclusive jurisdiction in the federal and state courts located in New York County, plus a mutual waiver of jury trial
findings.why: A margin comment asks Halyard to accept New York law and exclusive New York courts in 12.10 and 12.11; the text is unchanged but the request is a change to non-English governing law and jurisdiction.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to move to New York law, but we can offer English law with non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
